Description: Caster can stop bleeding on a wound that is bleeding up to 3 hits per round (total). Target may not be moved or bleeding will resume at prior rate
Caster may stop bleeding on a wound that is bleeding 1 hit per round. For 1 hour, target can move at no more than a walking pace or bleeding will resume at prior rate
Allows caster to stop bleeding from 1 wound that is bleeding at rate of 1 hit per round
As Clotting I, except that caster can stop bleeding in a woud that is bleeding up to 3 hits per round (total)
Allows caster to completely mend a damaged minor blood vessel (a vessel that bleeds at up to 3 hits per round, not major arteries or veins)

As Cut Repair I, except that caster can repair wound(s) that bleed(s) for up to 3 hits per round (total); three 1 hit per round wounds or one 3 hits per round wound or one 2 hits per round and one 1 hit per round wound can be healed
Caster can repair any one damaged vein. Target cannot move (under his own power) without reopening wound. Recovery time is 1-10 days

Allows caster to repair any one damaged artery. Target cannot move (under his own power) without reopening wound. Recovery time is 1-10 days depending upon the size of the artery and the severity of the damage
Allows caster to reattach 1 severed limb. Also requires the use of the other 3 Lay Healer Joining spells to make limb fully functional. Limb is fully functional after 10-100 days
As Flowstop III, except that all blood loss (i.e., hits per round) from one wound is stopped

Target is kept in a state of suspended animation and prevented from dying for the duration of this spell (i.e., the body is "preserved" and the "soul" will not leave the body). Also requires the use of the other Suspend Life I spell (on the Nerve and Organ Mastery spell list)
As Clotting I, except that all blood loss (i.e., hits per round) from one wound is stopped

Allows caster to remove any one blood clot. Will counter Clotting Curse (on the Evil Cleric list, Curses). This spell has no affect on bleeding wounds that have clotted (i.e., "clots" in this sense apply only to internal blood clotting)
As Cut Repair I, except that it will stop bleeding and close any one wound
As Suspend Life I, except for duration and the requirement of the other Suspend Life II spell (on the Nerve and Organ Mastery spell list)
As Unclotting, except will affect all blood clots in the target
As Joining, except caster must cast the other 3 Lay Healer Joining True spells and the limb is fully functional in 10 minutes
Allows caster to control all internal and external blood flow in the target. As long as the target remains immobile, bleeding can be halted until the wounds can be healed
Allows caster to restore all the blood in any 1 target's body. Recovery time is 1-10 days

Allows caster to cast one of the lower level spells on this list each round. SPECIAL NOTES 1) See Section 7.2 for more on damage and healing. 2) When a bleeding wound does not specify whether the wound is on a vien or an artery, roll d100. A 01-60 results in a vein; a 61 or more results in an artery. BLOOD MASTERY
